name: Stillness Stance
description: Stand so still that blows seem to land on a thing long since cast in the ground.

name: Weight Retort
description: Hand back the full weight of a heavy blow through a locked and planted frame.

name: Fatigue Absolved
description: Wash all weariness from the limbs of yourself or an ally with a long unbroken breath.

name: Heaving Press
description: Lean on a seized foe with a pressure that only grows until it stops resisting.

name: Unshifting Mass
description: Sink the entire body into its place so that nothing short of the earth itself could move it.

name: Dread Hammer
description: Swing a blow from the very ground up whose weight is felt in every body round it.

name: Plague Release
description: Release the whole body of yourself or an ally from poison and sickness in a single long exhale.

name: Rooted Vigor
description: Draw vigor up from the ground into every muscle for as long as the stance is kept.

name: Planted Oath
description: School stance sworn to hold the ground until the blow that answers it has landed.

name: Pinning Mass
description: School blow in which the whole body falls onto one point and holds the foe down.

name: Pillar Sacrament
description: School rite of standing as a pillar that gives strength to the allies who stand behind it.

name: Ending Weight
description: Drop the entire weight of the frame at once with a ceiling of ruin that breaks all in reach.

name: Nothing Else There
description: For one breath the body fills its place so wholly that no blow or effect can exist there; no qi mechanic explains it.

name: Wound Denial
description: Refuse the hurt of a blow at the instant it lands and let the flesh stay whole.

name: Hurt Return
description: Give a share of each hurt received back to the striker through the touching flesh.

name: Scar Erasure
description: Smooth old scars and healed breaks from the body of yourself or an ally until it is as new.

name: Debt Sight
description: Read every hurt and weariness a body has carried and judge what it can still bear.

name: Redeemed Flesh
description: Call back lost flesh and bone of yourself or an ally and make the body whole.

name: Unburdened Strike
description: Throw a blow that carries no weariness and no hesitation from the body behind it.

name: Curse Dissolution
description: Dissolve a curse or binding that clings to the flesh of yourself or an ally.

name: Open Ledger
description: Wipe a wound of the last breath from the body so it counts as never received.

name: Cleared Account
description: School discipline of the body that owes no hurt and mends what it is owed.

name: Fair Exchange
description: School answer that returns to the striker exactly the harm it dealt and no more.

name: Weighed Mercy
description: School rite of granting one whole recovery to a body at the edge of ruin.

name: Tally Fall
description: Bring down every unpaid hurt of the fight on the foe at once with the ceiling of ruin.

name: Harm Unmade
description: A harm done to the body in the last breath is taken from the world and never was; no qi mechanic explains it.

name: Weight Unmeasured
description: A blow has no weight until it lands and then carries the weight of all that struck the body; no mass effect explains it.
